entries.name: Rush: warning and shelter
entries.summary: Flickering lights and approaching sound warn of a dangerous passage through Hotel rooms.
body: Locate a usable hiding place when the warning appears, then enter before Rush reaches you. Listen for it to pass before leaving.
Do not rely on a fixed countdown or assume every flicker has the same cause. The dark Greenhouse and run modifiers change the available cues.
facts: Roblox · DOORS · The Hotel · standard run

entries.name: Seek: Hotel chase route
entries.summary: The Hotel chase rewards reading the route while continuing forward.
body: Follow Guiding Light at intersections and crouch through highlighted low openings. In the final hallway, avoid reaching hands and burning obstacles.
Stopping to loot or treating a wardrobe as the solution interrupts the escape plan. These notes cover the Hotel chase, not the Mines minecart sequence.
facts: Roblox · DOORS · The Hotel · standard run

entries.name: Screech: camera response
entries.summary: This threat calls for looking at the entity instead of looking away.
body: In dark Hotel rooms, react to the quiet audio and screen cues by looking around for Screech. Check above and below your normal eye line, then face it directly.
After it disappears, return attention to your route. Do not transfer this response to Eyes, which has a different viewing rule.
facts: Roblox · DOORS · The Hotel · standard run

entries.name: Hide: leaving shelter
entries.summary: A hiding place is temporary protection, not a permanent safe room.
body: Remaining hidden too long can trigger Hide and force you out. Watch the warning while also listening for the active threat outside.
Leave once the passage is clear, but remain ready for Ambush returning. Avoid memorizing one universal hiding duration because rooms and modifiers can change it.
facts: Roblox · DOORS · The Hotel · standard run

entries.name: Guiding Light
entries.summary: Blue guidance can point toward required objects and chase routes.
body: During Seek encounters, watch for the indicated door or low passage. When searching for an essential object, inspect highlighted locations rather than repeatedly opening the same containers.
Some modifiers reduce or remove hints. Check the run settings before expecting the same assistance shown in an ordinary Hotel walkthrough.
facts: Roblox · DOORS · The Hotel · standard run

entries.name: The Library: symbol code
entries.summary: Books provide symbol–number pairs; the paper determines their order.
body: Collect the marked books while avoiding Figure, then inspect the desk’s Solution Paper. Use its five positions to arrange the corresponding numbers.
Record symbol pairs carefully rather than treating the collection order as the code. Enter the completed code at the exit and leave once it opens.
facts: Roblox · DOORS · The Hotel · standard run

entries.name: The Electrical Room
entries.summary: The Hotel exit combines a search, a breaker puzzle and a final escape.
body: After the opening encounter, search for all ten breaker pieces while avoiding Figure. Unlock the breaker room and insert the collected pieces.
Solve the switch pattern shown by the panel, then head for the elevator when power returns. Treat collection, puzzle completion and reaching the exit as separate objectives.
facts: Roblox · DOORS · The Hotel · standard run

entries.name: Batteries and light charge
entries.summary: A battery replenishes compatible electronic lights, subject to available capacity.
body: Search containers and furniture surfaces while keeping your compatible light. After collecting a battery, check the charge indicator rather than assuming the light is now full.
A full light or missing compatible item can prevent pickup. This item is not the same as the Battery Pack found in other DOORS content.
facts: Roblox · DOORS · The Hotel · standard run
